basics.name: Hector Olea
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 12 years of experience designing, building, and scaling robust applications. Specialized in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. Focused on delivering testable, maintainable software through clean code, solid testing, and modern DevOps practices.

jobs.summary: Maintained and enhanced an Insurance application built with Angular and Java microservices, refactoring 30% of the codebase to align with Spring Boot best practices for better scalability and maintainability.
highlights: Implemented JUnit testing across services, raising code coverage from 0% to 20% and strengthening overall quality and reliability.

jobs.summary: Supported a Financial Analytics application, ensuring its stability and performance.
highlights: Resolved incidents and tasks efficiently using ServiceNow, addressing user-reported issues and implementing timely solutions to minimize downtime.

jobs.summary: Developed and enhanced microservices for a banking application, integrating customer data via SSN and extending case and product management capabilities to improve functionality and user satisfaction.
highlights: Implemented initial automated tests across existing microservices, increasing reliability and maintainability.

jobs.summary: Maintained, supported, and developed new features for 15 microservices built with Spring Boot and Node.js, ensuring high performance and scalability.
highlights: Automated daily support tasks by creating bash and Python scripts, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort.
Migrated services to Walmart’s Cloud Native platform and Apache Kafka, enhancing scalability, resilience, and deployment efficiency while reducing costs.
Improved system reliability and security by implementing fault-tolerant mechanisms and modernizing Spring Boot, Docker, and project dependencies.

jobs.summary: Automated repetitive processes in an Airline Company to streamline operations, reducing manual effort and improving efficiency for the operations team.
highlights: Automated monitoring and incident management through Python/Bash scripting and REST APIs integrated with ServiceNow, improving reporting and reducing response times.

jobs.summary: Supported and maintained an Invoicing application capable of retrieving transactions from plain text files via FTP interfaces, ensuring seamless data integration and processing.
highlights: Optimized Oracle database performance by tuning SQL/PLSQL code and automating bulk data loading with SQL Loader, significantly improving processing speed and efficiency.

jobs.summary: Maintained and supported the SIMBAD database system, which housed census data for Mexico, ensuring accuracy and optimal performance.
